context.zh: 旗舰种按公众魅力选拔以募集资源，不自动具备大生境包络同域物种的伞护效应（Simberloff 1998）。
context.en: Selected for public appeal and fundraising rather than large-area habitat co-occurrence (Simberloff 1998).

context.zh: 旗舰种属社会传播角色，移走它未必像关键种那样引发食物网与群落结构剧变（Caro & O'Doherty 1999）。
context.en: A socio-marketing role; its removal need not trigger food-web collapse like a keystone species (Caro & O'Doherty 1999).

context.zh: 旗舰种服务于公众传播与筹款，而非像指示种那样用于监测环境变化或生物多样性状态。
context.en: Serves public outreach and fundraising rather than monitoring environmental or biodiversity state.

context.zh: 伞护种按大面积生境需求与同域物种共现率选拔，不同于按公众魅力选拔的旗舰种（Andelman & Fagan 2000）。
context.en: Defined by spatial habitat requirements and co-occurrence rather than public charisma (Andelman & Fagan 2000).

context.zh: 伞护种强调空间生境覆盖范围，关键种强调单位丰度对群落互作网络的不成比例影响（Simberloff 1998）。
context.en: Focuses on spatial habitat coverage rather than disproportionate per-capita community impact (Simberloff 1998).

context.zh: 划定伞护种保护边界需以维持最小可存活种群（MVP）与集合种群连通性为前提（Wilcox 1984）。
context.en: Sizing an umbrella reserve requires minimum viable population (MVP) and metapopulation connectivity (Wilcox 1984).

context.zh: 关键种由群落互作强度决定（如赭色海星），无需拥有伞护种那样广阔的家域面积（Power et al. 1996）。
context.en: Defined by interaction strength (e.g., Pisaster sea star), not by a large home range (Power et al. 1996).

context.zh: 关键种是实证生态学属性，许多关键种（如海星、高原鼠兔）因缺乏大众外貌魅力而非天然旗舰种。
context.en: An empirical ecological property; many keystones (sea stars, plateau pikas) lack popular charisma.

context.zh: 顶级捕食者型关键种（如海獭、海星）常通过下行控制驱动跨营养级的营养级联（Estes et al. 2011）。
context.en: Apex-predator keystones often drive top-down trophic cascades across food webs (Estes et al. 2011).

context.zh: 自愿市场买方对信用的认购意愿与溢价常受雪豹、眼镜熊等旗舰种魅力驱动，但核证本身不能仅凭旗舰种故事（Peng et al. 2026）。
context.en: Voluntary buyer demand and price premiums are often driven by flagship charisma, though verification requires multi-taxa evidence (Peng et al. 2026).

context.zh: 多项信用规程（如 Savimbo 美洲豹信用与 ERA 伞护种规程）以伞护种家域划定项目空间边界，包络同域群落净增益（ERA 2025）。
context.en: Crediting protocols (e.g., Savimbo jaguar credits, ERA protocol) use umbrella home ranges to bound project area and co-occurring gains (ERA 2025).

context.zh: 关键种缺失引发的营养级联与食物网退化需纳入一篮子多维指标核证，不能用单一树种造林替代（Wauchope et al. 2024）。
context.en: Trophic cascades and food-web functions driven by keystone species must be captured in multi-metric baskets rather than monoculture planting (Wauchope et al. 2024).

context.zh: “一篮子多维指标”依赖对生境恢复或污染削减敏感的多类群指示种核证真实净增益，防范单一种树或放生漂绿（Wauchope et al. 2024）。
context.en: Basket-of-metrics accounting relies on multi-taxa indicator species to verify genuine recovery and prevent monoculture greenwashing (Wauchope et al. 2024).

context.zh: 与旗舰种、伞护种并列为三类经典代理物种（Caro & O'Doherty 1999）。
context.en: One of the three classic surrogate species classes alongside flagship and umbrella species (Caro & O'Doherty 1999).

context.zh: 多类群指示种组合构成生物多样性信用“一篮子指标”的核证底座（Wauchope et al. 2024）。
context.en: Multi-taxa indicator baskets form the verification backbone of biodiversity credits (Wauchope et al. 2024).

context.zh: 为伞护种保护区网络的面积与廊道设计提供种群动力学基础。
context.en: Provides the population-dynamic basis for sizing and connecting umbrella reserve networks.

context.zh: 关键捕食者移除实验是揭示营养级联的经典起点。
context.en: Keystone predator removal experiments are the classic empirical origin of trophic cascades.
